runtime_tests.reason: G01/C01/C02/C03/C04-P3 (AgingStart, Begin, Reserve, Forward, Commit): produce from the literal before equals the whole independent frame and every after page; observation op/lsn/actor/status/ordinal/order/kind/txn match the parent base row; observe of the golden reproduces the same after pages; C03-P3 observe_borrowed rejects a dirty scratch with InvalidInput and otherwise restores a zero tail; before/after Root3 row_high are 0/0 for G01 and 7/7 otherwise; decode_layout accepts the C04-P3 frame under Profile3.

G01/C01/C02/C03/C04-P2 are the unmodified parent literals under the parent Profile2: the modified generic code instantiated for Catalog2 produces and observes them byte-equal, with C03-P2 observe_borrowed as above.

produce and observe both return: C04-P2-UNDER-P3 Queue(UnsupportedFormat) (Profile2 Root2 under the Profile3 binding), C04-P3-UNDER-P2 Queue(UnsupportedFormat) (Root3 under Profile2, no fallback), C04-ROOT-V4 Queue(UnsupportedFormat), C04-JOB-V2-FREE Queue(UnsupportedFormat) (bank scan, ordinal 40), C04-JOB-V4-SELECTED Queue(UnsupportedFormat) (selected ordinal 0); no frame byte is written. A Profile1 binding returns IdentityMismatch from produce, observe, observe_borrowed and decode_layout.

produce and observe both return: C03-ROW-RESERVED Unsupported (selected Job3 kind3 RowId1 registry16), C04-ROW-TERMINAL Unsupported (selected Terminal registry16), C04-ROW-SAME-ACTOR Unsupported (Row Job3 of the same actor in the bank scan), C03-KIND2-ROWID Queue(Corrupt) (Job3 kind2 with RowId bytes is never read as kind3).

C04-ROW-HIGH-FRAME (fully resealed Commit frame whose after Root3 row_high is 8) observe returns Corrupt; the same before still produces the C04-P3 frame and pages; Row3::encode_root_page with the before Root3 (row_high 7) and the moved cell returns OrderMismatch leaving a 0xa5 output unchanged, and with the C04-P3 after Root cell returns the C04-P3 after Root page.

For all 64 cells of the C03 and C04 banks, catalog3::decode_job on the Profile3 cell equals catalog::decode_job on the parent cell in state, generation, source, status, undo, object, pair, lease/adoption LSN, outcome, cursor, sequence, statement, mutation, commit_q, release_start, catalog_bytes, projection, last_step, budget and cleanup; only the version byte and nonzero sender digests differ. catalog3::decode_root_page equals the Root2 view in every shared accessor with row_high 7; catalog3::verify_census and decode_jobs_page accept. No fallback: Root2 under catalog3, Root3 under catalog, Job2 under catalog3 and Root version4 are UnsupportedFormat. C03-ROW-RESERVED[1], C04-ROW-TERMINAL[0], C04-ROW-SAME-ACTOR[5] are UnsupportedState (row::decode_job accepts them as JobScope::Row; JobView::catalog gives None); C04-JOB-V2-FREE[40] and C04-JOB-V4-SELECTED[0] UnsupportedFormat; C03-KIND2-ROWID[1] Corrupt.

validate_transaction(C04 before Tx descriptor, profile, Status home, Some(root ordinal1)) is Ok for (Profile3, catalog3::JobView) and (Profile2, catalog::JobView), IdentityMismatch for the crossed pairs and for Profile1; transaction_remaining gives equal arrays for both views and IdentityMismatch for a Terminal view.

catalog3::source_bytes >= row::source_bytes, the wrapper+Job3 cell chain and every measured Row job/root chain; its Root decode bound is row's; retention_obligation::row::source_bytes >= Root3 decode and descriptor bounds and differs from the Catalog value by at most the Root decode difference; prints the values and deltas.

Every retained type term of semantic_catalog/resources.rs has equal size in the Profile2 and Profile3 instances (JobView and its Option/Result nests, RootView, JobCells, RootContext, CoreInput, FrameSpec, TransactionTransition, Computed); source_branches() equals the recorded U1-C0 runtime-r2 C2_SEMANTIC_BRANCHES values; frame/catalog_image/descriptor/run_retained/schema are equal; prints both censuses and the compute/total/borrowed deltas.

literal_layout.cases.tsv: header + 20 rows: id, class, profile(2|3), base (parent cases.tsv id for op/lsn/ordinal/actor/plan/order), jobs, root, jobs_page, allocator, anchor, catalog, status, undo, transaction, aging, frame, after0..after7, expect. Each literal is named by its sha256.
literal_layout.blobs.tsv/blobs.bin: 38 dense (sha256, offset, bytes) literals including the Profile3 ID1 envelope f49d4bb2...; a literal byte-identical to a parent raw blob is not stored and is resolved from the parent raw directory; the harness verifies every sha.
literal_layout.author: python3 -I author.py, stdlib pathlib/struct/hashlib only, reads parents as bytes and asserts: Profile3 envelope == envelopes/profiles.bin[:4096]; G01-P3 before Root3 cell == root3/initial-root.bin; parent and Profile3 C01->C04 Root and Aging-descriptor chains hold. r2: maps Job sender digests SHA(tx2)->SHA(tx3) and checks the Profile3 bank chain C01->C04. r4 (same outputs as r2): also asserts every accepted literal of G01 and C01..C04 is byte-equal to the replay of the pinned version2 serializer through serializer3.load() with row_high 7 set on the post-Aging state.
literal_layout.serializer3.py: Reusable stdlib serializer: load() returns the pinned version2 serializer module with profile(), free_job() and root_page() replaced by their Profile3/Job3/Root3 forms (row_high from state key 'row_high', default 0); emit()/main() disabled.
